subject: Accepted: ink stroke model v1 (surface units = content-box width, 5-dp rounding, UUIDv7 ids, LWW by stroke id)
body: Lead decision: adopt as written. 12b persists strokes exactly in this shape in ink_layers.strokes (jsonb) and derives the Pydantic model from packages/shared/ink.schema.json; 18 merges by stroke id. Any change after this needs a new contract with a version bump.
